title: 单手刺击
author: Kingdom Come Combat
first_page: 输入：下，左，右。用剑单手直刺对方的面部
second_page: 单手刺击，伤害略低，但是容易命中且直击要害，属于出其不意的打法，在长剑上效果更佳

en_us.title: Single-Handed Thrust
en_us.first_page: Input: Down, Left, Right. Thrust the sword one-handed into the opponent's face.
en_us.second_page: The damage is a little low, but the thrust lands easily and goes straight for a weak point. It catches opponents off guard and works even better with a longsword.
